664a000000000000000000001.title: Getting Started with Blockly
664a000000000000000000001.description: Explore the Blockly drag-and-drop interface, learn how blocks work, and practice your first simple programs.

664a000000000000000000002.title: Printing to the Screen
664a000000000000000000002.description: Use Print blocks to display text and numbers on screen, similar to cout in C++.

664a000000000000000000003.title: Variables
664a000000000000000000003.description: Learn to create variables, assign values, and reuse them. Understand number and string variables.

664a000000000000000000004.title: Arithmetic Operations
664a000000000000000000004.description: Perform addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division with operator blocks and apply them to real problems.

664a000000000000000000005.title: User Input
664a000000000000000000005.description: Interact with users by asking questions, reading input, processing it, and showing results.

664a000000000000000000006.title: Conditional Statements
664a000000000000000000006.description: Use if/else to branch logic based on comparisons and handle multiple cases in one program.

664a000000000000000000007.title: Loops
664a000000000000000000007.description: Repeat groups of commands with repeat and count blocks. Combine loops with variables to solve summation problems.

664a000000000000000000008.title: Functions
664a000000000000000000008.description: Package commands into named functions, call them repeatedly, and build functions with parameters and return values.

664a000000000000000000009.title: Capstone Projects
664a000000000000000000009.description: Combine everything you learned to build three real apps: a calculator, a guessing game, and a grade report.
